brief.goal: Build a 5-touch automated win-back flow for users who completed onboarding but haven't created a report in 14 days
brief.brand_voice: plain, specific, second person, no exclamation marks; operations vocabulary (reports, data sources, teammates)

assumptions.why: estimated from the data (DEMO DATA): 28 a month, mean threshold crossings over 3 complete month(s) to 2026-09
estimated from the data (DEMO DATA): 17.5%, 22 of 126 matured threshold crossings came back within 30 days with no flow
not stated; set to 30 days so the whole flow (last touch on day 18) plus a week is inside it

entry_filters: clicked or replied to any email in the last 90 days (opens do not count: privacy proxies inflate them)
gate_policy.note: AMBER gate: engaged recipients only, no volume growth (AMBER gate as supplied)

cohort.name: Customer.io win-back cohort: Ridgeview
cohort.plain_english: People who completed onboarding and then went 14 days without the core action (created a report). They enter on day 14, once per lapse, and leave the moment they do the core action again.
entry_rules: completed onboarding (onboarding_step_completed where step_index = 3) at least once (evaluated at entry)
14 or more calendar days since the core action (feature_used where feature = reports), counted from their own last one, or from qualifying if they never did it
queued on the first daily run after crossing (a missed run catches up for 3 days) and pushed from the ledger lcm_flow_entries, which holds each lapse once
exclusions: no consent for any channel in the flow
cohort.exit_rule: leaves the moment they create a report again (checked before every step)
cohort.platform_pattern: Event-triggered campaign on core_action_lapsed_14d, re-entry allowed. Exit: performs feature_used where feature = reports (conversion goal with exit on conversion). Holdout: True/False branch on the event attribute in_holdout.

sql.postgres:
-- dialect: postgres
-- Ridgeview, winback flow: who is due on the run date (today).
-- Qualifying: completed onboarding (onboarding_step_completed where step_index = 3). Core action: created a report (feature_used where feature = reports).
-- Entry: 14 calendar days or more since the last core action (or since qualifying, if none since): the anchor date is
-- between 14 and 17 days before the run date, and this lapse (user, anchor date) is not yet in lcm_flow_entries.
-- A missed run catches up for 3 days. The ESP applies consent and suppression; this query decides who crossed.
-- Holdout: holdout_bucket < 15 (salt 'ridgeview_winback_14d'); identical in every dialect and in engine/sql/dialects.holdout_bucket.
WITH qualified AS (
  SELECT s.user_id, MIN(s.event_at) AS qualified_at
  FROM (SELECT qe.user_id, qe.event_at FROM track_events qe WHERE qe.event_name = 'onboarding_step_completed' AND (qe.properties ->> 'step_index') = '3' AND qe.user_id IS NOT NULL) s
  WHERE CAST(s.event_at AS DATE) <= CURRENT_DATE
  GROUP BY s.user_id
),
last_core AS (
  SELECT s.user_id, MAX(s.event_at) AS last_core_at
  FROM (SELECT ce.user_id, ce.event_at FROM track_events ce WHERE ce.event_name = 'feature_used' AND (ce.properties ->> 'feature') = 'reports' AND ce.user_id IS NOT NULL) s
  JOIN qualified q ON q.user_id = s.user_id
  WHERE CAST(s.event_at AS DATE) <= CURRENT_DATE
  GROUP BY s.user_id
),
anchored AS (
  SELECT q.user_id, q.qualified_at, lc.last_core_at,
         CAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(lc.last_core_at, q.qualified_at), q.qualified_at) AS DATE) AS anchor_date
  FROM qualified q
  LEFT JOIN last_core lc ON lc.user_id = q.user_id
)
SELECT u.user_id, u.email, a.qualified_at, a.last_core_at, a.anchor_date,
       (CURRENT_DATE - a.anchor_date) AS days_inactive,
       u.email_consent_at IS NOT NULL AS email_consent,
       u.sms_consent_at IS NOT NULL AS sms_consent,
       ((('x' || substr(md5(u.user_id || ':ridgeview_winback_14d'), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int) % 100) AS holdout_bucket,
       ((('x' || substr(md5(u.user_id || ':ridgeview_winback_14d'), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int) % 100) < 15 AS in_holdout
FROM anchored a
JOIN users u ON u.user_id = a.user_id
LEFT JOIN lcm_flow_entries l ON l.flow = 'ridgeview_winback_14d' AND l.user_id = a.user_id AND l.anchor_date = a.anchor_date
WHERE a.anchor_date BETWEEN (CURRENT_DATE - 17) AND (CURRENT_DATE - 14)
  AND l.user_id IS NULL
ORDER BY u.user_id

-- dialect: postgres
-- Ridgeview: threshold crossings by month (would-be entrants) and the natural return rate: the share of
-- matured crossings (at least 30 days old) whose next core action came within 30 days, with no flow running.
WITH qualified AS (
  SELECT s.user_id, MIN(s.event_at) AS qualified_at
  FROM (SELECT qe.user_id, qe.event_at FROM track_events qe WHERE qe.event_name = 'onboarding_step_completed' AND (qe.properties ->> 'step_index') = '3' AND qe.user_id IS NOT NULL) s
  WHERE CAST(s.event_at AS DATE) <= CURRENT_DATE
  GROUP BY s.user_id
),
last_core AS (
  SELECT s.user_id, MAX(s.event_at) AS last_core_at
  FROM (SELECT ce.user_id, ce.event_at FROM track_events ce WHERE ce.event_name = 'feature_used' AND (ce.properties ->> 'feature') = 'reports' AND ce.user_id IS NOT NULL) s
  JOIN qualified q ON q.user_id = s.user_id
  WHERE CAST(s.event_at AS DATE) <= CURRENT_DATE
  GROUP BY s.user_id
),
anchored AS (
  SELECT q.user_id, q.qualified_at, lc.last_core_at,
         CAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(lc.last_core_at, q.qualified_at), q.qualified_at) AS DATE) AS anchor_date
  FROM qualified q
  LEFT JOIN last_core lc ON lc.user_id = q.user_id
),
core_and_anchor AS (
  SELECT s.user_id, s.event_at
  FROM (SELECT ce2.user_id, ce2.event_at FROM track_events ce2 WHERE ce2.event_name = 'feature_used' AND (ce2.properties ->> 'feature') = 'reports' AND ce2.user_id IS NOT NULL) s
  JOIN qualified q ON q.user_id = s.user_id AND s.event_at >= q.qualified_at
  UNION ALL
  SELECT user_id, qualified_at AS event_at FROM qualified
),
seq AS (
  SELECT user_id, CAST(event_at AS DATE) AS d,
         LEAD(CAST(event_at AS DATE)) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_at) AS next_d
  FROM core_and_anchor
),
lapses AS (
  SELECT user_id, (d + 14) AS crossed_on, next_d
  FROM seq
  WHERE (next_d IS NULL OR next_d > (d + 14)) AND (d + 14) <= CURRENT_DATE
)
SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', l.crossed_on) AS DATE) AS month,
       COUNT(*) AS entrants,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.crossed_on <= (CURRENT_DATE - 30) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matured,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.crossed_on <= (CURRENT_DATE - 30) AND l.next_d IS NOT NULL
                 AND l.next_d <= (l.crossed_on + 30) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returned
FROM lapses l
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

postgres.ledger:
-- dialect: postgres
-- The ledger of win-back entries: an outbox. queue writes due lapses as 'pending', the job pushes every pending row,
-- and mark sets them to 'pushed'. A lapse is in here at most once, so nobody enters twice for one lapse. Create once.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lcm_flow_entries (
  flow VARCHAR NOT NULL,
  user_id VARCHAR NOT NULL,
  anchor_date DATE NOT NULL,
  holdout_bucket INTEGER NOT NULL,
  in_holdout BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR NOT NULL,
  queued_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  pushed_at TIMESTAMP,
  detail VARCHAR,
  PRIMARY KEY (flow, user_id, anchor_date)
)
-- Upgrading from v2: ALTER TABLE lcm_flow_entries ADD COLUMN detail VARCHAR;

SELECT 'ridgeview_winback_14d', e.user_id, e.anchor_date, e.holdout_bucket, e.in_holdout, 'pending', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
FROM (
WITH qualified AS (
  SELECT s.user_id, MIN(s.event_at) AS qualified_at
  FROM (SELECT qe.user_id, qe.event_at FROM track_events qe WHERE qe.event_name = 'onboarding_step_completed' AND (qe.properties ->> 'step_index') = '3' AND qe.user_id IS NOT NULL) s
  WHERE CAST(s.event_at AS DATE) <= CURRENT_DATE
  GROUP BY s.user_id
),
last_core AS (
  SELECT s.user_id, MAX(s.event_at) AS last_core_at
  FROM (SELECT ce.user_id, ce.event_at FROM track_events ce WHERE ce.event_name = 'feature_used' AND (ce.properties ->> 'feature') = 'reports' AND ce.user_id IS NOT NULL) s
  JOIN qualified q ON q.user_id = s.user_id
  WHERE CAST(s.event_at AS DATE) <= CURRENT_DATE
  GROUP BY s.user_id
),
anchored AS (
  SELECT q.user_id, q.qualified_at, lc.last_core_at,
         CAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(lc.last_core_at, q.qualified_at), q.qualified_at) AS DATE) AS anchor_date
  FROM qualified q
  LEFT JOIN last_core lc ON lc.user_id = q.user_id
)
SELECT u.user_id, u.email, a.qualified_at, a.last_core_at, a.anchor_date,
       (CURRENT_DATE - a.anchor_date) AS days_inactive,
       u.email_consent_at IS NOT NULL AS email_consent,
       u.sms_consent_at IS NOT NULL AS sms_consent,
       ((('x' || substr(md5(u.user_id || ':ridgeview_winback_14d'), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int) % 100) AS holdout_bucket,

LEFT JOIN lcm_flow_entries l ON l.flow = 'ridgeview_winback_14d' AND l.user_id = a.user_id AND l.anchor_date = a.anchor_date
